meta.purpose: One clear sentence: what is this Boros instance being optimized for?
meta.notes: Any notes about this world model — design decisions, what you changed and why.

category_one_key.name: Category One Name
category_one_key.description: One or two sentences. What does this category measure? Be precise. Boros reads this.
category_one_key.final_state: A concrete role or vivid reference. Something GPT-4o can model. 1-2 sentences max.

rubric.level_1: What a raw, untuned LLM does with zero SKILL.md evolution. Describe the failure mode with specific, observable behavioral markers. What is present? What is absent?
rubric.level_2: Better than baseline but reachable by good prompting alone. What improved? What still fails? Describe the partial state specifically.
rubric.level_3: Requires actual SKILL.md evolution to reach. What behavioral change is present that wasn't at Level 2? Be specific — GPT-4o needs to be able to see this in a response.
rubric.level_4: The ceiling. What a world-class version of this system would do. Must be genuinely hard. A raw Claude Sonnet with good prompting should not be able to hit this without SKILL.md evolution.
